transcription: Here's how you're gonna spend a full 24 hours of eating in Osaka. I had a lot of snacks on this trip, so I narrowed it down to my favorites to create this perfect one day, a tenorary. For breakfast, you're gonna have this amazing fluffy french toast made with Japanese milk bread. It's from Saki Moto Bakery, and I promise you've never had a french toast like this. Still dreaming about it. If you're craving a next sandwich, then you have to go to Dakason. These are probably the biggest exandos in Japan. Fluffy and creamy, any egg lover's dream. They also have these giant steak sandos. There must have been about 20 pieces of steak in there. The first week tree had to grin a year for these surprisingly very crispy pastries. They had a strawberry and lemon meringue pie one, both were great. You could never be too full for an own a Gary. And this own a Gary shop knows what they're doing. I got the one that came with tuna and two GME eggs. It was actually so insane. So simple, yet so good. And then how to be basic and I got the salmon and mayo one. For dinner, you're gonna need some sushi. I don't know why sushi row isn't talked about more. But welcome to Sushi Row, it's actually a chain all over Japan. The flavors were so cool and the pieces were actually really big. They had salmon and cream cheese and a Gary, mozzarella and basil. I had a chicken curry one honestly the options were unless the quality was perfection I'm sure to save room because once you're done here You're gonna head over to the Dalton-Borris street market and you're gonna do a little dessert crawl This market is super lively. There's lights everywhere. I got the melon bread It was super crispy on the outside and it was really soft on the inside it came with ice cream too You know the tanghulu doesn't look that good here But it was actually the best one that I had and then some sweet potato chips with sugar and salt now for nightlife It's time to go cry. So let's go to ghosts everyone in Japan can dance this man was killing it I couldn't stop staring and DJ at ghosts was actually just playing banger after banger We had a great time and for the most part everyone is very respectful so that's a great thing to say. Oh and we also went to the pink.
